note: Watchlist baseline from the discovery sweep of 18 August 2026 (see watchlist.md). 124 products across 104 terms URLs: 101 readable by plain fetch, 23 needing the agent. Deliberately holds NO RATES — it is a diff anchor for identity and routing only. Every product's lastChecked is null because no collection run has happened yet; the first real sweep sets it and reports changes rather than re-dumping. httpStatus/readable are the values MEASURED on the sweep date, so a later change in either is itself a reportable move (a page going 200 -> 403, or marketing-only -> yes).
